title: UST-Fuse Engine: Uncertainty-Aware Spatiotemporal Radar Fusion Framework (S2)
description: UST-Fuse Engine (software component S2) is the reference C++17 implementation of the Uncertainty-Aware Spatiotemporal Radar Fusion method for detecting, classifying and tracking small unmanned aerial vehicles. It ingests synchronised radar measurements and produces continuously-maintained tracks, each carrying an object class, a calibrated classification probability and separate estimates of epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty. The pipeline performs normalisation and angular encoding, computes an integral measurement-quality index, applies two-level (temporal and cross-feature) attention, classifies with an ensemble of heteroscedastic models followed by temperature scaling, and performs probabilistic multi-target association that blends a kinematic likelihood with a semantic compatibility coefficient (attenuated under high epistemic uncertainty) while adaptively inflating the measurement-noise covariance from the measurement quality. Reference software accompanying the manuscript on Uncertainty-Aware Spatiotemporal Radar Fusion (UST-Fuse). Part 2 of 3 (S1, S2, S3).
